ShadowHook 2.0.1 (bytedance/android-inline-hook), MIT - see LICENSE.

Source: https://github.com/bytedance/android-inline-hook/archive/refs/tags/v2.0.1.tar.gz
  sha256 77B954483CEE4EEAD5F2AB4571B19D00C5BFA6DB1B656E62A3DC7C136A14AEDB
  cpp/ = shadowhook/src/main/cpp/ from that tarball (upstream CMakeLists.txt dropped;
         built as a static library by ../../CMakeLists.txt).
Maven AAR com.bytedance.android:shadowhook:2.0.1 (sha256 2CAD01FF4D59542958775E19F281981A7E84B39670B5FAE75905B8511E10C7CD)
  was checked and only ships libshadowhook.so (no static prefab), hence the source build.

Local integration patches:
  cpp/shadowhook.c: sh_linker_init()/sh_task_init() skipped when
  PICOET_SHADOWHOOK_NO_LINKER_MONITOR is defined. They dlopen libshadowhook_nothing.so,
   which does not exist in a static build. This project hooks already-mapped libraries
   by address/name and discovers the plugin itself; it does not use pending hooks.
   cpp/sh_island.c: ELF-gap fallback skipped when PICOET_SHADOWHOOK_NO_ELF_GAP
   is defined. PicoET places Hook B in the plugin's executable tail without changing
   its ELF segment sizes. ShadowHook cannot track that reservation, so this build
   only allocates its islands in owned anonymous mappings; allocation failure must
   fail the hook instead of overwriting the leaf. This applies to all hooks, not
   just their initial installation order. Both defines are set in hook/CMakeLists.txt.
